releaseNotes:
🛡️ OpenTV v2.4.4 (Build 51) - Anti-White-Screen Shield & Clean TV Back Navigation:
• Eliminated White Screen Glitch: Fixed TV Series back navigation trap where pressing Back inside the series modal previously dropped through to exit
• Native Android Dark Shield: Set persistent #070d18 dark background on Android ConstraintLayout and WebView XML layers, preventing any white flashes during transitions
• Inline Dark HTML/Body: Prevented default browser white canvas paints before stylesheet evaluation
• Safe External Player Fallback: Blocked webview URL navigation in the Android APK so stream URLs never take over the app view
• 100% Remote D-Pad & Back key stability verified across all live, VOD, and series views
